optimality_invariant: For positive ridge, the exact linear solution has penalized objective no greater than the zero predictor, hence unpenalized training SSE no greater than target SSE. Repeating this for each route-residual solve preserves that bound. Observed relative RMSE above 1 violates the bound and invalidates the float32 normal-equation result as an architecture-capacity verdict.
decision: Preserve the catastrophic held-out result as negative solver evidence, not as proof that rank-1044 coefficient realization is impossible. Authorize one read-only numerical-optimality audit of the identical fixed rank, features, routes, ridge ratio, records, and gates using chunk-accumulated float64 Gram/cross matrices and explicit objective checks. No hyperparameter or architecture variation is authorized.
claim_boundary: Negative and numerically invalid float32 normal-equation coefficient evidence only; no architecture incapacity, installed model, physical runtime, autonomous quality, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
